t: Liqrot happarasha shenayim miqra veechad targum
s: Liqrot happarasha shenayim miqra veechad targum ubo y' seipim: ap al pi sheadam shomea kol hattora kullah kol shabbat betzibbur — chayyab liqrot leatzmo bekol shabua veshabua parashat oto hashshabua shenayim miqra veechad targum. Upasuq sheen bo targum — qoreehu g' peamim. (Va"atarot vedibon vego'" sheyyesh bo targum yerushalmi: "maklelta umalbeshta vego'" — tzarik liqroto):

Haqqore shenayim miqra veachar kak loez kol milla umilla bilshon laaz shemmebin — lo yatza yede chobato bimqom targum, lepi shehattargum meparesh kamma debarim sheen lehabin mittok hammiqra. Abal haqqore (beperush hattora shemmeparesh kol milla umilla yoter mipperusho shel hattargum — yesh omerim shehu yoter tob mehattargum. Veken haqqore) b' peamim miqra ubepaam g' chozer velomed kol happarasha im perush rashi"y shehu banuy al yesod hattalmud — hare zeh moil yoter mehattargum, shehu meparesh yoter. Veyesh omerim shehattargum zaka mippene shennittan besinay, kegon "yegar sahaduta". Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Umikkol maqom, kol yere shamayim yesh lo liqrot hattargum vegam perush rashi"y. Umi sheeno mebin perush rashi"y — yesh lo liqrot beperush hattora shebbilshon laaz shemmebin:

Yesh nohagin liqrot kol parasha, ben petucha ben setuma, b' peamim, veachar kak hattargum aleha miyyad qodem sheyyiqra parasha sheniyya. Veken bekol parasha. Veyesh nohagin liqrot kol pasuq b' peamim vehattargum alayv miyyad. Uminhag zeh nakon yoter, ki ken hayu osim bizman shehayu metargemin biqriat hattora betzibbur, shehayu metargemin kol pasuq bipne atzmo. (Abal min haddin yakol liqrot shenayim miqra veechad targum bekol inyan sheyyirtzeh). Upasuq haacharon tob lekoplo velachazor uleomro, kede lesayyem battora (ki ken bizman shehayu metargemin hayu mesayyemim bammiqra, shehayu kopelim pasuq haacharon):
Mi shehu ragil bepisqe teamim beal peh — tob sheyyiqra shenayim miqra beseper tora kasher bekol ereb shabbat veereb shabbat:

Chayyab lehashlim parashiyyotayv im hatztzibbur, shello yiqra beshabua zeh parashat shabua acher. Abal miyyom rishon veelak niqra im hatztzibbur, shekkebar hitchilu hatztzibbur parasha zo beshabbat bemincha. Umitzva min hammubchar sheyyashlim otah qodem sheyyokal beshabbat shacharit, ki ken tzivva rabbenu haqqadosh et banayv, shello yoklu shabbat shacharit qodem sheyyashlimu happarasha shenayim miqra veechad targum. Veim lo hishlim qodem akila — chayyab lehashlim achar akila ad hammincha. Abal mishsham veelak, kevan shehitchilu hatztzibbur parasha acheret — abar zemannah shel zot. Veyesh omerim shebbediabad yakol lehashlimah ad sop yom g' beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer leinyan habdala besimman rtz"t. Veyesh omerim shebbediabad yakol gam ken lehashlimah ad simchat tora, sheaz mashlimin kol hatztzibbur et kol hattora. Vetob lachush ledibrehem, shemmi sheabar velo hishlim bizmannah — yashlim ad sop yom g'. Veim lo hishlim — yesh lo lehashlim ad simchat tora shenayim miqra veechad targum, velo keotan sheomerim miqra lebad:

Yesh nohagin mittaam hayyadua lahem ligmor kol happarasha shenayim miqra veechad targum ereb shabbat achar chatzot. Veyesh nohagin ligmor kullah ereb shabbat shacharit achar hattepilla. Veshello lehapsiq kelal beemtza shenayim miqra veechad targum apillu bedibbur. Veim en lo targum — yiqra miqra b' peamim, veachar kak kesheyyihyeh lo targum yiqraennu. Abal min haddin en tzarik liqrot kol happarasha shenayim miqra veechad targum bepaam achat, ella apillu parasha achat hayyom miqra lebad uparasha acheret lemachar, veken kol yeme hashshabua, veachar kak miqra al hasseder:

Lepikak, melammede tinoqot sheggameru happarasha im hattinoqot paam achat — enam tzerikin lachazor veliqrotah b' peamim, ella yiqreu paam achat vehattargum. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshellamedu im hattinoqot perush hammillot bilbad, abal im lamedu perush hammiqra — yatzeu yede targum gam ken, veal derek shennitbaer lemala, veenam tzerikim ella lachazor veliqrot hammiqra paam achat im lo qareu im hattinoqot b' peamim:

Yesh mattirim liqrot shenayim miqra veechad targum bishat qeriat hattora, kemo shennitbaer besimman qm"v. Veyesh omerim sheyyotze yede chobato bishmiat haqria mehashsheliach tzibbur im shama kol happarasha beberur, veday sheyyiqra od paam achat im targum. Ella shellekattechilla en lismok al hashshemia, mittaam shennitbaer besimman n"t. Abal yesh omerim sheeno yotze kelal bishmiat hashsheliach tzibbur, shemmillebad shemia zo chayyab liqrot shenayim miqra veechad targum, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Ubishat haddechaq yesh lismok al sebara harishona:

En tzarik liqrot parashat yom tob leatzmo beereb yom tob, shehare kebar qara o yiqra parasha zo beshabbattah. Umikkol maqom, beereb simchat tora yiqra parashat "vezot habberaka" shenayim miqra veechad targum, sheakshav hu zemannah:

Hahaptarot shel kol hashshabbatot en tzarik liqrotan leatzmo min haddin. Ella shennahagu liqrotan, kede sheyyehe baqi bah veyodeah, ki shemma yiqrauhu lemaptir bebet hakkeneset. Ubed' parashiyyot yesh lo liqrot haptara shel d' parashiyyot shemmaptirin otah bebet hakkeneset, velo haptara shel parashat hashshabua. Veken beshabbat rosh chodesh umachar chodesh veshabbat chanukka. Veim era chatunna beshabbat bammeqomot shennohagim az lehaptir bebet hakkeneset "sos asis" — yesh lo gam ken liqrotah leatzmo, velo haptarat hashshabua, ki shemma yiqrauhu lemachar. Abal im ereu harbeh chatunnot beshabbatot zo achar zo — day bemah sheqqara "sos asis" barishona, veyesh lo liqrot bishar hashshabbatot haptarat hashshabua:
